clue.text: Outcry — group loses 500 before week following

indicators.note: before sets the shortened group ahead of the next piece
loses tells us the group sheds a letter, here the numeral that follows

parts.note: a squad is a group, as of soldiers or players
D is the Roman numeral for 500

explanation.surface: A team is caught short by five hundred people ahead of a following week, provoking public protest.
explanation.walkthrough: 'following' is a link word that only confirms the week comes last; 'loses' is the deletion signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A squawk is a loud complaint or protest, much like a public outcry.

clue.text: The man with a fish for curing

parts.note: the man is referred to as he
the ling is a long sea fish of the cod family

explanation.surface: A man carries a fish as a remedy.
explanation.definitionFit: Curing and healing are synonyms for making someone well again.

clue.text: Unable to see blanket coverage

parts.note: snow lies over the ground as a blanket
a window blind is a covering

explanation.surface: Someone cannot see the extent of blanket media coverage.
explanation.definitionFit: Snow-blindness is temporary loss of sight from glare off snow, leaving a person unable to see.

clue.text: Hostess on stage I shan't include

indicators.note: include says the letters sit inside the phrase on stage I shan't

explanation.surface: A performer refuses to include something in her act on stage.
explanation.definitionFit: A geisha is a Japanese woman trained to entertain guests, a professional hostess.

clue.text: Initially walk over stream at abbey

indicators.note: initially points to the first letter of walk

parts.note: O is the cricket abbreviation for over
a burn is a Scottish word for a small stream

explanation.surface: Start by walking across a stream to reach the abbey.
explanation.walkthrough: Woburn Abbey is a stately home in Bedfordshire, England.
explanation.definitionFit: Woburn Abbey is a famous English country house, so the name stands for an abbey.

clue.text: Battle to reach toilet after a drink?

indicators.note: after places the toilet word behind the drink word

parts.note: water is a drink
loo is British slang for a toilet

explanation.surface: Someone struggles to get to the toilet after having a drink.
explanation.walkthrough: Waterloo is the 1815 battle where Napoleon was defeated.
explanation.definitionFit: Waterloo is the Belgian site of Napoleon's final defeat, a famous battle.

clue.text: Prohibition on nearly everything that's commonplace

parts.note: a ban is a prohibition

indicators.note: nearly means the word for everything loses its final letter

parts.note: all means everything

explanation.surface: Banning almost everything is a dull and ordinary thing to do.
explanation.definitionFit: Banal describes something trite and ordinary, so it is a synonym of commonplace.

clue.text: Desiring removal of area with best seats

indicators.note: a removal shifts things around, as when moving house, so the letters of desiring are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone wants an area taken away from the best seats.
explanation.definitionFit: Ringside seats at a boxing match are the closest to the action and the most prized.

clue.text: Female who is the centre of attention when there is a lot of buzzing about

definitions.text: Female who is the centre of attention when there is a lot of buzzing about

parts.words: Female who is the centre of attention when there is a lot of buzzing about
parts.note: reads as a socially dominant woman amid busy chatter, but also as the fertile female at the heart of a hive of buzzing insects

explanation.surface: A woman who loves being the centre of attention amid all the excitement.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means both the hive's egg-laying female and a woman who dominates her social circle.

clue.text: Making amends for a fashion in first gear

parts.note: ton is an old word for fashion or style, as in high society

indicators.note: first picks out the opening letter of gear

explanation.surface: Someone driving in first gear makes up for a fashion mistake.
explanation.definitionFit: Atoning means making reparation for a wrong, the same as making amends.

clue.text: Shining precious metal of little value

parts.note: Ag is the chemical symbol for silver, a precious metal
low can mean of small worth or value

explanation.surface: A precious metal that proves to be of little value after all.
explanation.definitionFit: Aglow means glowing or radiant, a synonym of shining.

clue.text: Sandy old-timer?

parts.note: suggests an elderly person called Sandy, but means an old-fashioned timing device that runs on sand

explanation.surface: An elderly man named Sandy.
explanation.definitionFit: This device measures time by sand trickling between two glass bulbs, an antique way of keeping time.

clue.text: Gold and black ball

parts.note: or is the heraldic term for gold
B is the abbreviation for black, as on pencils

explanation.surface: A ball coloured gold and black.
explanation.definitionFit: An orb is a sphere, so it can mean a ball.

clue.text: Shakespearean family with regal disposition

parts.note: kin means family or relatives

indicators.note: disposition means arrangement, so the letters of regal are set out anew

explanation.surface: A royal family in a Shakespeare play has a kingly temperament.
explanation.definitionFit: King Lear is one of Shakespeare's tragedies, so it is a Shakespearean work.

clue.text: Exaggerate about party

parts.note: over can mean about, as in fighting over something
a do is an informal word for a party

explanation.surface: Making a fuss about a party.
explanation.definitionFit: To overdo something is to take it too far, which is to exaggerate it.

clue.text: Oven vault cooking pastry-case

indicators.note: cooking suggests the letters of oven vault are mixed and worked up

explanation.surface: Baking something in a vaulted oven to make a pastry case.
explanation.definitionFit: A vol-au-vent is a small, light puff-pastry case, usually with a savoury filling.

clue.text: It catches fish from east Kent

indicators.note: from here signals that the answer is made out of the letters of east Kent, rearranged

explanation.surface: A fishing device that comes from eastern Kent, a county in south-east England.
explanation.walkthrough: 'from' is a weak anagram indicator; the blog queried it too.
explanation.definitionFit: A stake net is a fishing net hung on stakes driven into the shore or riverbed.

clue.text: Modern number you and I backed

indicators.note: backed means the word for you and I is read backwards

parts.note: we means you and I together

explanation.surface: A modern number that you and I supported.
explanation.definitionFit: New and modern are synonyms for recent or up to date.

clue.text: Two features on the coast in Scotland

parts.note: an eye is a facial feature
a mouth is another facial feature

explanation.surface: Two attractions found on the Scottish coast.
explanation.definitionFit: Eyemouth is a fishing town on the Berwickshire coast of south-east Scotland.

clue.text: Move quickly, being cut off in animal park

indicators.note: being cut off means the word loses its last letter

parts.note: to zoom is to move quickly

explanation.surface: Someone moving fast gets blocked inside a wildlife park.
explanation.definitionFit: A zoo is a park where animals are kept for public viewing.

clue.text: Sort of job provided by firm

definitions.meaning: a regular, reliable job is described with this word

explanation.surface: A kind of job offered by a company.
explanation.definitionFit: A steady job is a secure one, and steady also means firm and stable.

clue.text: Would one regret planting it?

parts.note: asks whether planting something leads to regret, playing on a herb whose name also means to regret

explanation.surface: A gardener wonders whether a planting will be regretted.
explanation.definitionFit: Rue is both a bitter herb grown in gardens and a verb meaning to regret.

clue.text: Unchangeable sports match?

definitions.meaning: something fixed in place that cannot be altered or moved
a scheduled sporting event or game

explanation.surface: A sports match whose result cannot be altered.
explanation.definitionFit: A fixture is a fixed fitting in a house and also a scheduled sporting contest.

clue.text: Doing some revision at university before having romantic appointment

indicators.note: before sets the university word in front

parts.note: up means in residence at university, as in up at Oxford
dating means going out on a romantic appointment

explanation.surface: A student revising at university before going on a date.
explanation.definitionFit: Updating means revising something to bring it up to date.

clue.text: Proclaim — to the converted perhaps

definitions.meaning: to declare publicly, as a sermon
completes the saying about telling believers what they already accept

explanation.surface: Announcing something to people who already agree.
explanation.definitionFit: To preach is to proclaim a message, and one may preach to the converted.

clue.text: Judge doing badly having little inner energy

indicators.note: inner puts the energy letter inside the muddled letters
badly suggests doing is done wrongly, so its letters are muddled

parts.note: E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: A judge who performs poorly because he has little energy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'badly' turns DOING into GIDON; 'inner' puts E inside it. 'little' marks E as an abbreviation. Gideon is a judge of Israel in the Bible's Book of Judges.
explanation.definitionFit: Gideon was one of the judges who led Israel in the Old Testament Book of Judges.

clue.text: Warm wear for someone taking a leap in the cold

definitions.text: Warm wear for someone taking a leap in the cold

parts.words: Warm wear for someone taking a leap in the cold
parts.note: reads as a sweater for a winter jumper, and also names the athlete who flies off a snowy ramp

explanation.surface: A warm sweater for someone jumping in freezing weather.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is both a winter-sports sweater and an athlete who leaps from a snowy ramp.

clue.text: Shared part of Sunday lunch

definitions.meaning: held or done together by more than one person
a roast cut of meat served at a traditional British Sunday lunch

explanation.surface: Sharing part of the Sunday roast.
explanation.definitionFit: Joint means shared, and a joint is a roast of meat for Sunday lunch.

clue.text: Made choice — put wrong mark

definitions.meaning: chose in an election or ballot
put a cross, the mark used for a wrong answer, as on a ballot paper

explanation.surface: Someone made a choice but marked the wrong box.
explanation.definitionFit: To have voted is to have made a choice, usually by marking a cross on a ballot.

clue.text: Jealous cardinals, five with evidence of debts

parts.note: E and N are two cardinal points of the compass, east and north
V is the Roman numeral for five
IOUs are written acknowledgements of debts

explanation.surface: Church cardinals grow jealous of five colleagues holding notes of debt.
explanation.definitionFit: Envious and jealous both describe resentment at what others have.

clue.text: Plan to remove car noise

indicators.note: remove suggests shifting the letters of car noise into new places

explanation.surface: A plan for getting rid of traffic noise.
explanation.definitionFit: A scenario is an outline or plan of possible events.

clue.text: Restless desire by the way when there's sudden pain

indicators.note: by places the street abbreviation next to the desire word

parts.note: St is the abbreviation for street, a way
an itch is a restless desire for something

explanation.surface: A restless craving on the road brings a sudden pain.
explanation.definitionFit: A stitch is a sudden sharp pain in the side, often from running.
